parsed.explanation: Documented traveller-facing exposures, not mere disapproval. The national document regime is a universal exposure: X markers eliminated, passports reissued by birth sex, reports of passports blocked or confiscated and travellers stranded, plus a stated fraud/permanent-ineligibility pathway and case-note tagging at entry; allied governments issued advisories. Facilities bans operate in many divisions, one municipality here enacted a severe restroom ordinance, and custody practice is documented as birth-sex placement — the August 2026 case shows a woman with a female licence held in a men's jail, searched by a male guard, and denied hospital care, while her attackers went unarrested and she was charged. State hate-crime law omits gender identity, no state non-discrimination law, and marker changes require surgical proof, so remedy is thin. No general presentation offence or organised police sweeps, which keeps this above the 0.25 tier. Undercount-floor homicide figures are not used.
